item.description: I apologise for updates on the BM website being somewhat limited as of late! But, due to the pandemic, of course, there hasn’t been a great deal of things to report to you all.

item.title: Postponement of Bernie Marsden Collection Sale | Bernie Marsden
item.description: In the wake of Bernie Marsden’s recent passing, the scheduled Gardiner Houlgate sale of the Bernie Marsden Collection has been deferred indefinitely. Bernie’s esteemed status within the guitar community and consultations with his family have prompted a respectful delay before proceeding with the event. For additional information, please visit the Gardiner Houlgate website.

item.title: New album release 'Working Man' | Bernie Marsden
item.description: BERNIE MARSDEN - WORKING MAN will be released, as originally planned, on Friday 24th Nov 2023. The album contains 12 brand new Bernie Marsden penned tracks.
